svg.aria-label: ASan-30 crash-triage scores per model for the base, calibrated 1.0x and random 1.0x variants
svg.text: FIGURE · ASAN-30 CRASH TRIAGE · 14 MODELS · SAME 30 SANITIZER TRACES PER VARIANT
ASan-30 crash triage: calibrated and random edits change root-cause scores by small, non-significant amounts
Counts of 30 traces. Gray ring: unedited base. Blue dot: calibrated B2 + B3 at 1.0x. Orange ring: norm-matched random direction at 1.0x. The thin line joins base to calibrated.
Root cause = the answer names both the bug class and the culprit function. The right column gives the paired root-cause change and its exact McNemar p (unadjusted).

svg.text: Pooled root-cause change over 14 x 30 = 420 pairs: calibrated +2.1 pp (95% CI -0.8 to +5.0, p = 0.20); random +0.2 pp (p = 1.00).

No root-cause cell survives Holm correction. Keyword scoring, greedy decoding, one seed. The 30 traces are the retained crucible sanitizer suite (sha256 66e5b9a8...f6b2). Gemma-2-27B: HOLD, not plotted.
